title: नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणमा शैक्षिक सामग्रीे प्रयोगको अध्ययन
authors: जाेशी Joshi, कल्पना कुमारी Kalpana Kumari
nepali: यो लेख ‘नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणमा शैक्षिक सामग्रीे प्रयोगको अध्ययन’ मा केन्दित छ । यसको उद्देश्य डोटी जिल्लाका विद्यालयमा दैनिक प्रयोजनका शैक्षिक सामग्री प्रयोगको स्थिति पत्ता लगाउनु, नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणमा विद्यागत शैक्षिक सामग्री प्रयोगको स्थिति पहिचान गर्नु र नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणमा शैक्षिक सामग्री प्रयोगका समस्या र समाधानका उपायबारे बिश्लेषण गर्नु रहेको छ । यसका लागि संभावनाविहीन अन्तरगतको उद्देश्यमुलक र सुविधामुलक विधिको प्रयोग गरी डोटी जिल्लाका ५ ओटा सरकारी र ५ओटा संस्थागत विद्यालयहरु छनोेट गरी, विद्यालयमा नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण गर्ने १० जना शिक्षकहरू र १० जना प्रधानाध्यापकहरु र प्रति विद्यालयबाट दश दश जना बिद्यार्थीहरुलाई अन्तवार्ता र छलफलमा समावेश गरिएको थियो । साथै कक्षा अवलोकन पनि गरिएको थियो । विद्यालयहरूमा दैनिक प्रयोगका शैक्षिक सामग्रीको प्रयोग प्रयाप्त गरेको छ भने विद्यालयमा भएका नेपाली भाषा शिक्षणका महत्वपूर्ण शैक्षिक सामग्री गोजीतालिका र फलाटिन पाटीको उपयोग न्यून गरिएको छ । स्थलगत अध्ययनको क्रममा केही विद्यालयमा शैक्षिक सामग्रीका रूपमा शब्दपत्ती, तस्वीर र वाक्यपत्ती प्रयोग गरिए पनि उक्त सामग्री बीचका र पछिल्ला बेन्चका विद्यार्थीहरूले पढ्न र बुझ्न सक्ने उपयुक्त आकारमा पाइएन । केही विद्यालयहरू आर्थिक समस्याको कारण शैक्षिक सामग्रीहरूको प्रबन्ध गर्न असमर्थ छन भने आर्थिक अवस्था राम्रो भएका विद्यालयहरू पनि इच्छा शक्तिको अभावको कारण शैक्षिक सामग्रीहरूको प्रबन्ध गर्न पछि परेका देखिन्छ । भाषा शिक्षणमा श्रव्यदृश्य सामग्री प्रयोग गरेर शिक्षण गर्दा उपयोगी हुन्छ तर यसतर्पm विद्यालयका प्रधानाध्यापक एवं भाषा शिक्षकहरूको ध्यान गएको छैन । शिक्षकहरू तालिम प्राप्त भएपनि तालिममा प्राप्त गरेको सैद्धान्तिक ज्ञान र व्यावहारिक सीपको प्रयोग कक्षा कोठामा गर्न उनीहरू पूर्ण रूपमा सफल नदेखिएको हुँदा अझै सामग्री सङ्कलन निर्माण र प्रयोग सम्बन्धमा उनीहरूलाई प्रोत्साहित गर्नु पर्ने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: This article is focused on "A Study of the Use of Educational Materials in the Teaching of the Nepali Language". Its objectives are to determine the status of the use of educational materials for daily purposes in schools in Doti district, to identify the status of the use of subject-based educational materials in the teaching of the Nepali language, and to analyze the problems and solutions regarding the use of educational materials in the teaching of the Nepali language. For this, using the purposive and convenience methods within a non-probability framework, 5 government schools and 5 institutional schools in Doti district were selected, and 10 teachers teaching the Nepali language in the schools, 10 head teachers, and ten students from each school were included in interviews and discussions. Classroom observation was also carried out. While schools have made adequate use of educational materials for daily use, the use of important educational materials for Nepali language teaching available in schools, such as word charts and flannel boards, has been low. During the field study, although some schools used word cards, pictures, and sentence cards as educational materials, those materials were not found to be of a suitable size for students sitting in the middle and back benches to read and understand. While some schools are unable to arrange educational materials because of financial problems, it appears that schools with a good financial condition have also fallen behind in arranging educational materials because of a lack of willpower. Using audio-visual materials in language teaching is useful, but the attention of head teachers and language teachers in schools has not gone in that direction. Even though teachers have received training, they have not been seen to be fully successful in applying in the classroom the theoretical knowledge and practical skills acquired in the training, and therefore it appears that they still need to be encouraged in relation to the collection, preparation, and use of materials.

informal_english: This article zeroes in on "A Study of the Use of Educational Materials in the Teaching of the Nepali Language". Its goals are to figure out how educational materials for everyday purposes are being used in schools in Doti district, to see where things stand with the use of subject-based educational materials in Nepali language teaching, and to look at the problems and possible fixes when it comes to using educational materials in Nepali language teaching. For this, using purposive and convenience methods within a non-probability setup, 5 government schools and 5 institutional schools in Doti district were picked, and 10 teachers teaching Nepali in those schools, 10 head teachers, and ten students from each school were included in interviews and discussions. Classroom observation was done too. While schools have been making good enough use of educational materials for everyday use, the use of important Nepali language teaching materials available in schools, like word charts and flannel boards, has been low. During the field study, even though some schools used word cards, pictures, and sentence cards as educational materials, those materials weren't a suitable size for students sitting in the middle and back rows to read and understand. Some schools can't arrange educational materials because of money problems, but it looks like schools that are in good financial shape have also fallen behind in arranging educational materials because they're lacking the willpower. Using audio-visual materials in language teaching is helpful, but head teachers and language teachers in schools haven't really paid attention to that. Even though teachers have had training, they don't seem to be fully successful at putting the theoretical knowledge and practical skills they picked up in training to use in the classroom, so it looks like they still need to be encouraged when it comes to collecting, making, and using materials.
translator_notes: The Nepali term 'sansthagat vidyalaya' is rendered as 'institutional schools' (private/institutional schools in the Nepali context). 'Gojitalika' has been translated as 'word chart'; 'phalatin pati' as 'flannel board' (felt board). Minor OCR-like spelling variants in the source (e.g. 'सामग्रीे', 'बिश्लेषण', 'तर्पm') were interpreted from context without altering the meaning.
